hook.text: Ice cores reveal temperature swings of 10°C in a single decade. The ice age climate was violently unstable.

buildup.text: Dansgaard-Oeschger events caused rapid warming spikes, then gradual cooling, repeating every few thousand years.

discovery.text: Each swing reshuffled ecosystems: forests advanced, then retreated; animal ranges shifted overnight.

twist.text: Humans who survived these whiplashes needed extreme behavioral flexibility—not just physical toughness.

climax.text: Our ability to change tools, diets, and strategies rapidly may owe everything to these chaotic swings.

punchline.text: Wild climate made a wildly adaptable species.

quiz.question: What are Dansgaard-Oeschger events?
options: Rapid climate temperature swings during the ice age
